conventions.basis: N=a+a-, P_kl=bk+bl+ (k<=l), Q_kl=bk+bl-, M_kl=bk-bl- (k<=l), F_{sigma}_{j}_{s}=a^sigma bj^s; p/m encode +/-
conventions.deformed_relation: b_j^s a^sigma = a^sigma b_j^s - ghat_{sigma,j,s}, ghat = gb*kappa (odd central nilpotent tag; gb even scalar, kappa odd central, kappa^2=0)
conventions.gamma: [X,Y]_def = [X,Y]_0 + sum_alpha ghat_alpha C_alpha(X,Y) + central scalars; doc gamma_gb = sum_alpha gb_alpha C_alpha
conventions.scalars: structure constants and cocycles are reported modulo C*1 (adjoint representation / up-to-scalar prescription); the central parts are reported separately
